qa.title: Q1979 (Mar. 20, 2026)
qa.question: If I choose options 1 and 2, can I resolve option 2 first, then select an enemy follower for option 1 after looking at the card I drew?
qa.answer: No. When required to select targets for any part of a card or ability, all targets must be selected first. In this case, you must select an enemy follower after deciding which options to choose. Then, the ability is resolved in the order as written.

qa.title: Q1978 (Mar. 20, 2026)
qa.question: If I select an engaged enemy follower with option 1 of this follower's Fanfare ability, will it refresh at the start of its controller's next turn?
qa.answer: No. Although the Fanfare ability's "engage it" effect will not apply to a follower that is already engaged, the "it doesn't refresh during its controller's next start phase" effect will still apply.

qa.title: Q2011 (Mar. 20, 2026)
qa.question: I have this card with at least 4 prayer counters on my field, and it has been given Ward by another card's ability. If it becomes Boxed via Nahtnaught, Cursed Queen's ability, does it retain Ward after it is no longer Boxed?

qa.title: Q2010 (Mar. 20, 2026)
qa.question: I have this card with at least 4 prayer counters on my field, and its attack or defense has been modified. If it becomes Boxed via Nahtnaught, Cursed Queen's ability, what happens to its attack and defense after it is no longer Boxed?
qa.answer: It would retain the modifications to its attack and/or defense. Followers that become amulets and return to being followers retain their attack and defense values. Those values simply aren't referenced while they are amulets.

qa.title: Q2009 (Mar. 20, 2026)
qa.question: I have this card with at least 4 prayer counters on my field. If it becomes Boxed via Nahtnaught, Cursed Queen's ability, is it still treated as a follower?
qa.answer: No, it would be treated as an amulet because its "While this has at least 4 prayer counters, it is a follower" ability would be lost.

qa.title: Q2008 (Mar. 20, 2026)
qa.question: If this card has fewer than 4 prayer counters, can it attack?
qa.answer: No. Amulets can't attack, be attacked, or take damage.

qa.title: Q2007 (Mar. 20, 2026)
qa.question: If this card has fewer than 4 prayer counters, can its attack and defense values be referenced?
qa.answer: No. It still possesses attack and defense values, but you treat the card as if it doesn't have them, and they can't be referenced by abilities.
